title: 'We have done all our homework' to get EU candidate status: Kosovo's PM Albin Kurti
summary: FRANCE 24 hosts Albin Kurti, the prime minister of Kosovo, a country that declared its independence from Serbia back in 2008 and sees itself as part of the European family. But four years after applying to join the EU, Kosovo has still not received candidate status. We explore Kosovo's path towards the EU, and the broader European and regional dynamics surr…
